label: A｜閱讀紀錄
extra: Layout A: a botanical-green narrow left navigation rail occupying 235px width, tall clear project name at rail top, understated version metadata at rail bottom. White continuous reading document filling right side with comfortable max 780px reading column. Headline starts in document rather than a giant hero. A compact one-line status band below opening body. Four section headings clearly spaced with generous vertical gaps. A signature green gently outlined semantic before/after comparison spans the reading column under "前後差異", two equal text columns separated by one thin rule. Test evidence begins below as an open ruled list without cards. Dominant gesture is excellent calm reading and margin alignment.
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop website visual composition mockup for a Traditional Chinese university assignment development record. Render only the actual webpage edge to edge, landscape 1440 by 1100 composition, no browser chrome, no device framing, no photographs, no fake screenshots, no logos, no watermarks. This is a READ surface for a teacher evaluating a student LINE Bot project, not a marketing page. Exceptional professional typography, functional quiet navigation, coherent grid, comfortable real body text, editorial care. Fixed visual system across all three variants: deep botanical green #15634E, pale green #EDF3EE, white #FFFFFF, ink #14251F, clear sans Chinese typography similar to Noto Sans TC. No gradients, neon, glass, decorative patterns, emojis, floating metric cards, generic dashboard cards, or uppercase kicker above title. Green carries navigation and selected meaningful frame surfaces; reading column stays white. The project name is exactly "待辦小幫手". Main headline "記下待辦，也找得到。" Opening body "LINE Bot 改善版，新增查詢功能，讓使用者回看自己的最新 10 筆待辦。" Navigation labels "改善紀錄", "前後差異", "重新測試", "使用說明", "第一版封存". Crucial factual status rendered visibly: "14 組本機測試通過" and "LINE 真人測試待完成". There are four required sections "原本的問題", "修改內容", "前後差異", "重新測試結果". Actual facts: first version could record but not query; v2 adds 查询 command, latest ten personal entries and useful empty-state help; signed webhook tested locally; no LINE live chat test yet. Hard content example is a before-after response comparison. Input "查詢". Before "使用方式：記錄：待辦事項". After "你的待辦事項（共 1 筆）" followed by "1. 星期五交報告". In test results show three honest rows: "記錄：星期五交報告" => "已記錄：星期五交報告。", "記錄：" => "請輸入要記錄的待辦事項。", "你好" => "提供記錄與查詢提示". Clear text link "保留第一版 commit 與測試紀錄". All content must look like a readable real website, no invented counts or claims. Do not include A/B/C labels inside page, labels will be supplied outside the mockup.
Layout A: a botanical-green narrow left navigation rail occupying 235px width, tall clear project name at rail top, understated version metadata at rail bottom. White continuous reading document filling right side with comfortable max 780px reading column. Headline starts in document rather than a giant hero. A compact one-line status band below opening body. Four section headings clearly spaced with generous vertical gaps. A signature green gently outlined semantic before/after comparison spans the reading column under "前後差異", two equal text columns separated by one thin rule. Test evidence begins below as an open ruled list without cards. Dominant gesture is excellent calm reading and margin alignment.

label: B｜前後對照
extra: Layout B: full-width slim white masthead with project title at left and text links at right. Main opening is a two-thirds headline and brief rationale on left, one-third quiet pale-green status note on right; restrained no giant number stats. The dominant focal region directly below is a large wide before/after comparison with horizontally aligned column headings "第一版" and "改善版", pale green improved side, thin green dividing rule and readable real response text. Pair the problem and change explanation as clear prose above the comparison rather than repeating card containers. Below a normal document section "重新測試結果" begins with a compact clean data grid of Input/Expected/Actual without rounded cards. Put archive link in upper navigation. The visitor immediately sees what changed and can scroll naturally to verify it.
